component.name: OmaCal
component.summary: A minimal desktop calendar for Google, iCloud and CalDAV

description.p: A minimal desktop calendar client with five views, live background sync, and full create, edit and delete against your real calendar — Google Calendar, iCloud, or any CalDAV server, including CalDAV task lists.
Five views, and the keys to move between them:

ul.li: Day, Week, Month, Year and Big Year — a fourteen-row ribbon of the whole year
List mode draws Day, Week and Month as a list of days and leaves out the empty ones, so a quiet month is four rows rather than thirty-one headers
Search finds a recurring event once, resolved to the occurrence nearest today, rather than once per occurrence

description.p: Events, and the people in them:

ul.li: Drag to move an event, resize it by an edge, or sweep empty grid to start a new one
Recurring events edit at three scopes: this occurrence, this and following, all events
Guests can be added, removed or marked optional, and saving asks who to tell rather than always mailing the room
A new invitation posts a notification that stays on screen until it is answered, and the header keeps score of what changed around your meetings: who declined, what moved, what was cancelled

description.p: Sign-in tokens live in your keyring, never on disk, so a minimal session needs a Secret Service provider running — gnome-keyring, KeePassXC or kwallet. There is no telemetry and no server of ours in the path: your calendar data moves between this machine and your calendar provider, and nowhere else.
